12b973af3a31c98d8324b4bb080a51b40f4e7aac: A resort on a human scale, Alpe di Siusi focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 73 km of runs are ideal for a 3 to 4 day stay, especially with family or for skiers who don't need to keep changing their playground. Alpe di Siusi has kept the authentic identity of a mountain village, far from the concrete resorts of the 1970s. People come here for the clean air, the untouched landscapes and a friendly atmosphere that stands in contrast to the industrialisation of skiing in some large ski areas. The altitude of Alpe di Siusi (1227 m at the bottom, 2220 m at the top) helps it maintain decent snow cover in midwinter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is best to check conditions before finalising a booking. The budget for a stay in Alpe di Siusi is clearly high: 80€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Alpe di Siusi keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most skier profiles without disappointing.
